subject: Final go/no-go + paperflow: signoff windows & start date
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@brightcart.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Final go/no-go + paperflow: signoff windows & start date

Jordan —

Thanks again for the productive evaluation week. We captured the MAP updates you requested and I want to lock the final path to signature so we can guarantee the May 31 start slot on our Dedicated capacity. Summary and asks below: 

- MAP status: scope locked (prefix caching + 2 model variants), engineering approval pending (Camila).
- Evaluation outcome: latency and throughput met the BrightCart perf targets in the P50/P90 checks; see attached MAP_v3.pdf for the runbook and perf excerpts.
- Legal/SOW: we circulated the SOW (SOW_redwood_v1.docx). Legal has one remaining redline on the data retention clause; Kimberly is coordinating.

Immediate asks:
1) Can BrightCart provide final signer name + email for DocuSign by EOD Wed 5/19? That lets us route the envelope and avoid a signature gap.
2) Confirm target first-day (start date) as Mon 5/31 — if we miss the DocuSign window this week, earliest target moves to Mon 6/7.

Proposed signoff timeline (compressed):
- Wed 5/19 by 5pm PT: internal exec approval at BrightCart + signer info (DocuSign).
- Thu 5/20: Redwood legal to accept final redline or propose compromise.
- Fri 5/21: DocuSign envelope out; countersign expected by Tue 5/25.
- Mon 5/31: Start date / onboarding day 0.

If you prefer a canary start (half traffic) we can also do a phased ramp with pre-warm hours on 5/31.

Attachments: MAP_v3.pdf (runbook), SOW_redwood_v1.docx (draft)

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-minute call this afternoon to finalize.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@brightcart.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Narang <priya.narang@brightcart.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 12:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final go/no-go + paperflow: signoff windows & start date

Alex —

Thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers:
- We'll confirm the signer by EOD Wed 5/19. Likely candidate is our VP Product, Lina Chen (lina.chen@brightcart.com).
- We prefer the full go-live on 5/31 rather than a canary, but can be flexible if you recommend a short phased ramp.

Two outstanding items from our side:
1) One small privacy ask: can we shorten the retention window in the SOW appendix to 90 days for ephemeral logs?
2) Our procurement team asks for an invoice example to align payment timing — can Kimberly attach a one-line sample?

We can do a 15-minute call Wed 5/19 at 10am PT to walk execs through the MAP and final signoff steps.

—Jordan
Jordan Liu
Head of Integrations
BrightCart

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@brightcart.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final go/no-go + paperflow: signoff windows & start date

Jordan —

Appreciate the rapid review. A few operational notes from engineering:
- The pre-warm step to cache the top 50 prefixes will take ~3 hours; we can run that overnight if signatures complete by Fri 5/21.
- We'll provision the Dedicated pool on Thu 5/27 to run final smoke tests; that gives us a full week buffer before 5/31.
- If retention is reduced to 90 days we need a short SOW amendment clarifying which logs are ephemeral vs. audit (audit logs still kept 1 year per SOC 2 controls). Karthik, can we get a one-paragraph amendment ready for that clause?

Camila
Sr. Product Engineer, Deployments
Redwood Inference

Jordan / team —

Quick legal and finance updates:
- Retention: happy to accept 90 days for ephemeral application logs. We'll add a 1-paragraph amendment to the SOW distinguishing ephemeral logs (90 days) from audit logs (12 months) and attach as SOW Appendix B. Karthik will draft by EOD Thu 5/20.
- Invoice: attached a one-line sample invoice (stub) for procurement planning — filename: Redwood_invoice_sample.pdf.
- DocuSign: once you confirm Lina Chen as signer we'll send the envelope from legal@redwood.com; please confirm the sign order (single signer is fine).

Next steps:
1) Jordan confirms signer by 5/19 EOD (we have that as the target).
2) Karthik shares the SOW Appendix B (retention amendment) by Thu 5/20.
3) We route DocuSign Fri 5/21 if all approvals are in place.

If those three items complete on schedule we'll keep the 5/31 onboarding. If not, we move to 6/07.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
